subject: Request: NexTech customer story + artwork clearance for case study
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Ramos <sophie.ramos@nextech.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Apr 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: NexTech customer story + artwork clearance for case study

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We drafted a short customer story (attached link below) that highlights the performance and cost improvements you saw after switching to Redwood Dedicated. We'd like to publish a 1‑page case study and include:

- NexTech logo (RGB and monochrome) on the PDF and marketing landing page
- A short quote from Jaya Patel (CTO) and a 2‑sentence summary of outcomes (latency and cost savings)
- A composite screenshot of the integration (non-sensitive UI only)

Can you confirm whether NexTech is comfortable with the above and, if so, please loop in legal for a quick logo usage approval? If there are any required phrasing or confidentiality notes, we can include them verbatim.

Link to draft: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-nextech-case-draft
Estimated publish date: week of May 13

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a 15m call if that helps.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: draft-case-study-v1.docx (link provided)

From: Sophie Ramos <sophie.ramos@nextech.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: J. Patel <jpatel@nextech.io>, NexTech Legal <legal@nextech.io>
Date: Mon, 29 Apr 2024 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: NexTech customer story + artwork clearance for case study

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for sending this over. Jaya (CC) is okay in principle with a short case study. I’ve looped in our legal team for logo and quote approval. A couple quick asks from product/marketing side: please make sure any screenshots are blurred to remove PII and that the headline does not state exact dollar figures — we can say ">30% reduction in inference cost" instead of a $ amount.

I’ll circle back once legal gives a thumbs up. If legal needs a formal release, we can sign.

—Sophie
Director, Product Marketing, NexTech
sophie.ramos@nextech.io

Attachment: none

From: NexTech Legal <legal@nextech.io>
To: Sophie Ramos <sophie.ramos@nextech.io>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: J. Patel <jpatel@nextech.io>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2024 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: NexTech customer story + artwork clearance for case study

Hi all —

We reviewed the draft. Legal is comfortable granting logo and testimonial usage with a short signed release. Two items for Redwood to confirm before we issue the signed file:

1) Final quote language to be used for Jaya Patel (CTO). Please supply the exact sentence to appear on the case study.
2) Confirmation that no NexTech customer PII will be published and that screenshots are redacted/blurred per Sophie’s note.

Once we have (1) and (2) satisfied, we will return an executed logo release and the official high‑res logo package. We can provide a standard one‑page release now; if Redwood requires any custom language, send redlines.

Regards,
NexTech Legal (on behalf of J. Patel)
legal@nextech.io

Attachment: nextech-brand-guidelines.pdf

From: Sophie Ramos <sophie.ramos@nextech.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, NexTech Legal <legal@nextech.io>
Cc: J. Patel <jpatel@nextech.io>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2024 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: NexTech customer story + artwork clearance for case study

Hi Aditya —

Jaya is happy with this suggested quote (please use exactly):
"Working with Redwood reduced our 99th‑percentile inference latency and lowered per‑token cost by more than 30% while keeping output quality consistent."

We’ve also confirmed screenshots will be redacted. Legal attached the executed logo release and the high‑res assets for you (see attachments). You’re cleared to:

- Use NexTech logo on case study PDF and marketing landing page
- Quote Jaya using the exact sentence above
- Use one redacted screenshot (no PII)

Please send a preview PDF of the final layout before publication — we just need a final signoff on placement and color usage.

Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Sophie
Director, Product Marketing, NexTech

Attachment: signed_logo_release.pdf; nextech_logo_rgb.zip
